client: herdr --session kampr-probe-w0-menu, forked under a 120x40 PTY, rendered off its own output bytes with ../vt.py
config: a throwaway XDG_CONFIG_HOME holding onboarding = false and [experimental] allow_nested = true — the latter only so the client will start at all from inside a herdr pane; nothing about the sidebar is customised

sidebar.separatorColumn: the 26th column is the │ between sidebar and layout
sections: one group row and one agent row per detected agent
sidebar.note: there are no tab rows and no pane rows in the sidebar at all — tabs live in the top strip, panes live in the layout

rightClick.sequence: ESC [ < 2 ; col ; row M then ESC [ < 2 ; col ; row m, SGR, over a client that set 1000/1002/1003/1015/1006 at startup (#376)
nothingHappens: empty sidebar space above the buttons
empty sidebar space at the foot
rightClick.anchor: top-left cell of the box is the clicked cell; the box flips upward when it would not fit below
rightClick.focusUnchanged: a right-click on the unfocused workspace row drew the menu and left the tab strip on the focused workspace — it does not select the row

dismissal.enter: closes it, and does not activate the first item — no rename editor appears
dismissal.q: leaves it open; it is not any-key-to-dismiss
dismissal.downArrow: leaves it open and changes not one cell — the menu has no keyboard highlight
dismissal.rightClickElsewhere: closes it and opens the menu for whatever is under the new pointer

activation.by: a left click on the item's own row
activation.Rename: a centred modal — 'rename workspace', the current label prefilled, footer '↵ save    ^c clear    esc cancel'
activation.Close: a centred modal — 'Close workspace?', 'bravo — 1 pane', footer '↵ confirm    esc cancel'

leftClick.newButton: creates a workspace immediately, labelled from the cwd (`tmp`), and switches to it — no menu

notMeasured: any screen narrower than 120 columns, where the 26-column sidebar is a larger fraction and the menu may be placed differently
the collapsed sidebar rail (prefix+b) — every reading here is with the sidebar expanded
a workspace with more than one tab's worth of agents, and whether the agents section gains rows that do respond
the middle button, double-click, and drag on any sidebar row
